newsitem.title: PAPUA NEW GUINEA: PNG drinking binge leaves 15 dead.
newsitem.headline: PNG drinking binge leaves 15 dead.

text.p: Fifteen young men have died and 16 were in hospital after a methylated spirits drinking binge in a Port Moresby squatter camp, a Papua New Guinea hospital official said on Thursday.
The official said a total of 53 people had been treated by the Port Moresby General Hospital since the drinking binge on Saturday, which followed the theft of 60 containers of methylated spirits.
Three of those still in hospital were in a critical condition and doctors feared the death toll could rise.
The official said the stolen methylated spirits was 96-percent pure alcohol and highly toxic.
